source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: While still waiting for a response Caelynn studies the sky once again.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: She estimates that the gathering storm will arrive in about seven hours.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: The group then decides to load up the wagon and head out in hopes of beating the storm.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: They plan to head back up the main road through town and continue north.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: This will give them a chance to warn the Mossford of the approaching storm and gather any supplies they might need.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Stafl and Lysandra, both in need of a good rest, lay down in the back of the wagon, using this time to recharge while they travel.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn prepares some tea while the rest of the supplies are loaded in the wagon.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: As the wagon approaches town it is clear that they are having a celebration.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Stafl begins to shout, in rhyme, to the crowd about the storm.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: He is quickly approached by the sheriff, who is not happy about the news during the celebration.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: It also becomes clear he is not a fan of signing, or rhyming in general.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: He warns the group about rumors coming from a town to the north about cultists using music to convert others.

routes.normalized_route: Elderwyld/Cities and Towns/Edge of the World/

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: The town, called Edge of the World, is about a one week trip to reach.

routes.normalized_route: Elderwyld/Cities and Towns/Edge of the World/

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: They warn the sheriff about tainted meat and Karsemine uses her Thaumaturgy to show them what to look for when people begin to change.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: They continue on north with Karsemine and Caelynn keeping an eye out for high ground for a place to stop for the night.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: While on this short trip everyone is able to relax and have a short rest.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Because of their timing leaving the town and their navigation skills, the wagon is able to make it far enough north to just hit the very edge of the storm and only get soaked.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: They are able to see the sheen of magic as the rain pools up and instead of the usual petrichor the rain smells savory.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine and Caelynn spot a good camping spot on the top of a conical hill.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: They leave the wagon and the animals at the bottom and make their way up until they reach a giant bowl of water surrounded by a grove of trees.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: From this position they can see out along the plains for a fairly long distance.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: After conferring with Lysandra, they determine that they are 3 days from Mirathorn and the next little town north along the road will be Mireward, about 5 days out.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Everyone gets comfortable, sentries are posted, and they get a peaceful night's rest.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: After another uneventful night, the group grabs their belongings and begins to walk back down to the wagon.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: As soon as they start Bonogo sees a huge double rainbow.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Thrin is so excited to see it that he thanks the group again for taking him out of the forest.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo is convinced that there is something on the next hill over where the rainbow appears to end.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna reminds him of an old Fey legend about making promises under a rainbow.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: The group decides to make a short detour to the hill Bonogo thinks the rainbow ended on.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: What they find at the bottom of the hill is a very old trail covered in thick brush.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: After only a brief discussion about continuing, the group slashes their way up the trail.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine, always keeping a sharp eye on her surroundings, is the first to notice something just off the trail.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: She picks up an iridescent scale, still warm to the touch.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: She shows it to Caelynn to make an arcana check, but she can't tell anything about it.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: As the group continues up the path the number of scales laying around continues to grow until it becomes obvious something is up ahead.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine becomes very nervous about reaching the top and finding something waiting.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: While Caelynn creates Good Berries for everyone, Karemine scouts ahead.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: The top of the hill is again shaped like a giant bowl, just as before, but this time instead of water this bowl is filled with detritus and the horrible smell of decay.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine sneaks back to the group and warns them that something is definitely living here.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo does not want to leave without taking a look himself, so Karsemine casts Pass Without a Trace and they both sneak back up.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: They slowly make their way back through the remaining brush to the lip of the bowl and suddenly Bonogo is overwhelmed with the scent of reptiles.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Down below on the floor of the bowl they can see a large amount of winged reptiles, between 40 and 50, and the remains of countless animal corpses along with human corpses with some remaining gear.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: The reptiles appear to be the size of a very large dog and their iridescent scales make them appear to be covered in rainbows.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Despite the danger, Bonogo is convinced the "treasure" is on the human remains and tells the rest of the group that this is a big score waiting to be picked up.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: As the group spends the next few minutes deciding what to do next, the majority want to leave right away, suddenly a large group of the reptiles fly up and away.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine is able to tell now that they are young drakes.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Based on their size five of these would be a tough battle for the group, so it doesn't look good if they are caught fighting the whole nest.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo decides now is a good time to check again on how many remained in the nest.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: What he finds is nine young drakes remain, but he also discovers two large elder drakes and seven more sitting on smaller nests.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Because of the spell from Karsemine he is able to sneak even closer without being seen.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: He is able to find a few valuable things right away: a metal slab with buttons and a pair of beat-up old boots.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: He decides not to push his luck further and heads back to the group.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: He is disappointed in the loot until he tries on the boots and discovers that they are the Boots of Crowing Wings.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: They allow him additional jumping distance.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Back at the wagon the sky still looks good, but Caelynn can feel the storm starting to build and Ephanna feels a strange magic forming.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: The group decides that it is best to find a spot quickly where they can make any sort of shelter from the storm.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: They continue up the path until they reach the next small hill.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Again they leave the wagon and hike half way up the hill before finding a suitable spot.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Thrin shows his craftiness by helping to create a shelter from the surrounding trees.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Stafl is on first watch, with little happening, until the sky darkens further and he can just make out a huge swarm of wings.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna takes the next watch, and the only notable thing that happens is they find a strangely flat rock, which they put into their pack.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Shortly after sunrise Caelynn decides to call Mirathorn again.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: After a pause she is finally connected with Frank, who sounds very hung over.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: He apologizes to her, telling Caelynn that the city resumed the Festival and it was a long night.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: She is very upset at the news about the festival, but before she can tell Frank he abruptly hangs up on her.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Now she is devastated.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: And things don't appear to be improving.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: In need of a friend, she approaches Lysandra to tell her what just happened, but Lysandra doesn't appear to notice that Caelynn is barely holding back tears.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Frustrated, Caelynn turns and walks away to gather her things.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Lysandra then notices Ephanna talking with her while she is brewing some tea.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: She takes the chance to approach Caelynn again and asks for some tea and finally notices the state that Caelynn is in.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Now it's Lysandra's turn to burst into tears.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: After collecting herself, she tells Caelynn that she has done a little investigation into the person they spoke about back in the city and how she finally sees how much the group does for her.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Again Caelynn turns and walks away, clearly not ready to talk.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna moves in to speak with Lysandra and tell her about the earlier call to Mirathorn.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Lysandra decides to make a call herself, but does not even get an answer.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Something seems wrong back at the city, but they cannot know for sure.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: Now the group must decide: continue on their mission to the swamp, or turn back and see what is happening at the city.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
lexical_plain: After a brief discussion, they agree to press on to the swamp.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The group turns their focus to the Reach; the vast Golden Fields to the north.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: If they decide to continue on, their destination is Mireward.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: If they decide to turn around, it's a multiday journey back to Mirathorn.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The first thing to do is break their camp and head back to the wagon.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The trail is damp from the rain and a magical sheen lies everywhere.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: In the distance to the west another storm appears to be building and there is a constant feeling of an approaching storm.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: After another failed attempt to contact Mirathorn by rockie-talkie, the group decides they need to come up with a plan to contact someone in the city they can trust.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: After some debate, they decide they should send a message to Professor Tealeaf, assuming the Wizard's College is the least likely to be affected by anything nefarious happening, and an encoded message to Grobnok in case the message gets intercepted.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The group decides on a spoken and written message about the problems they have had contacting the city and for someone there to contact them back.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: They send off a silver raven knowing that it would take the rest of the day for it to arrive.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: With nothing left to do for Mirathorn, the group loads up the wagon and continues north, all the while a gigantic storm from the west appears to be merging with a storm coming from the south.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Most of the day is spent quietly traveling.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Thrin asks Ephanna whether or not the forest can lie, which he is informed it does, while this breaks Caelynn out of her silent contemplation long enough to comment that people lie too; with a glance towards Lysandra.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: While walking along the wagon Karsemine notices something odd happening when birds fly over: something is wrong with the reflections in the puddles.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: It appears that the reflections are somewhat delayed, anything reflected in the shimmering water is a second late.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The group continues on when they see a cloud of dust as something is moving fast in their direction.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: They soon encounter a young rider on a horse at top speed.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: She slows long enough to say that they cannot stop unless they have food for her horse so that she can continue on.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The horse has clearly been running at full speed for a long time and could use a short break.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Caeylynn conjures some Good Berries for the horse and fetches some water.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Stafl immediately recognizes the soldier's uniform of the Elderwild Reach, the same uniform he wore before leaving and joining this group.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The woman introduces herself as Private Hester and she is carrying a sealed tube in her hand with reports for Mirathorn.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Lysandra requests a report right away.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Hester tells her of reports of mysterious music and people walking into the swamp, none of them responding when stopped.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine shows her the glassy eyes they have seen countless times, and Hester is even more worried that something very bad is happening.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: She scoffs when Lysandra tells her the group is headed there to take care of the problem, saying they would need a much bigger party.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Before turning to take off again, she tells Lysandra to speak to Commander Vale before heading into the swamp.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine begins to look for a good place to camp, but can't help wondering more about the mysterious puddles.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: She asks Caelynn for help and she casts Detect Magic using her Whisper Bottle.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Magic seems to be coming from everywhere, but she is able to see that the magic in the puddle is from conjuration.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn takes a small vial with her and Karsemine pokes the puddle with a stick.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Just then Bonogo leaps over them both and lands in the puddle, splashing everyone with water.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: They hold their breath waiting for something to change, but nothing else happens.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: So they continue to the next hill, looking for a good place to stop for the night.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: While sitting around the fire, Stafl uses Identify on the vial and isn't able to tell much except that no one should drink it.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: After another arcana check, it appears the magic is some sort of bleed from another plane of existence and something is conjuring it.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: They are even more concerned about the effect this will have on the flora and fauna in the area.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Suddenly Ephanna can hear a muffled voice coming from the rockie-talkie.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: They can just make out the code phrase before they realize it is Grobnok.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: What follows is not a great update from the city.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Grobnok took the rockie-talkie from Frank after it appears he has been compromised and he has not seen Sara recently.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The council was not able to find all the corrupted meat in time and now there is a full blown outbreak once again.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The decimated city guard is further reduced by the corruption so the council had no other option but to hire mercenaries.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: He and Tealeaf are working together to regain some control, which is mostly working.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The council instructs the group to continue on to the swamp where they believe this problem originates.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Finally, he tells them he will be the only one contacting the group going forward and will do his best to call each evening.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The group sits quietly near the fire until they are assaulted by gnats, except for Thrin, and they turn in early.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine takes first watch.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The night is quiet until she starts to hear a rhythmic sound on the wind coming from the north.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Stafl takes the next watch, and except for a pair of eyes that turns out to be a fox, his shift is quiet.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna is the last watch and as the sun starts to rise so does a strange mist, with a familiar savory flavor.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: With no call from Grobnok the group packs up and begins the walk back to the wagons.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn checks on the weather and it is very clear that a major storm is coming.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Where the two storms are meeting it appears to be hazy, but Caelynn quickly determines it is a huge hail storm.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: She directs the group to get moving and to be on the lookout for any place to shelter.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The ride is much more pleasant as both Lysandra and Caelynn are in much better moods.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Having a goal and helping the group really boosted morale.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Lysandra opens up to Ephanna about how poorly she is handling the mission she has been given.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: She is upset with how difficult it is to keep Mirathorn out of trouble, but is determined to get back to being the group leader.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: After a nice stretch of peaceful travel, one by one the each member realizes they are humming some sort of song.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Even more, they are all humming the same song.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Karesmine identifies it as the rhythm she heard the night before, and Ephanna figures out it is the song they all heard the Dustwalker perform at the festival.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Up ahead, at the fork in the road, is a small building and a sign indicating Mireward 20 miles north.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The small building turns out to be an abandoned restaurant specializing in meat on a stick.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine takes a quick look around and judges that the place was only recently abandoned, no more than a week ago.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The chalkboard menu out front has been hastily erased and now simply reads "headed south, north wrong".

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Inside the group finds a small sink, dishes neatly put away, and a trapdoor leading to a small storage area.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Here they only find a jar with a few skewers with old graying meat.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Returning outside, Caelynn takes another look at the weather and decides they may not be able to beat the storm north, so they decide to take shelter in the building.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine uses her survival skills to reinforce the structure so that the animals are protected as well.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Just in time as an incredible wall of hail smashes into the building and the surrounding area.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: For several minutes no one can hear anything except for the roar of the storm, then it quickly starts to fade as it moves on.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The sun is starting to get low, but the group thinks they can make it to Mireward around 10 o'clock.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: As they once again pack up the wagon they assess the damage the storm left.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Besides the trees being shredded, all else seems ok, until, not long after they left, Karsemine hears a distinctive sound: knocking on a door.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Even with her dark vision and her scouting skills, she is unable to find the source of the noise, and in fact cannot find anything that would have a door.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: While she is out scouting, Ephanna gets another call from Grobnok.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: He airs his frustration at having to help the city instead of partying at the festival, and says things are not getting better.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: There is an uneasy truce between the mercenaries and the "meat heads", but the "meat heads" have become more vocal and open in the recruitment for the Shepherd.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: And worse still, a gnome was found within the city to have the shimmering eyes, something that previously only happened to humans who became infected.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Stafl then argues with Grobnok about their effectiveness in dealing with the cultists before hanging up the rockie-talkie and giving it to Lysandra.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Then, not fully trusting her, or anyone from the city, takes it back and gives it to Caelynn.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: That's when Stalf casts Suggestion on Lysandra, intending to find out her motivations.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: He asks her to tell him her true intentions, to which she responds that her goal is to keep the team focused on going to the swamp and destroying the source of the cult.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: It is well into the night when they spot a wall in the darkness and can just make out a person standing guard at the top.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: He demands that the group stop and to identify themselves.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Stafl casts Light so he can more clearly see the group of heroes.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine, thinking of Lysanrda's new found leadership, says our leader should step forward.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: But Bonogo, believing that she means him, steps forward with a simple hello.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: The man's eyes grow big as he scans the rest of the group.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: "Is that little Lysandra?" he asks.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: "No dad, it's Lieutenant Lysandra now".

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 22 - Mireward Road and Lysandro.md
lexical_plain: And that is how they all met her father Lysandro.
